items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling  high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.summary: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an Oct. 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.
items.creator: Marina Temkin

items.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
items.summary: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker
